package.description: Fast, open-source disk space analyzer for Windows

en-US.description: Fast, open-source disk space analyzer for Windows
en-US.longDescription: Scans a drive or folder and shows where the space went: a live-updating tree, a squarified treemap, file-type breakdown, and instant search. Reads the NTFS MFT directly for WizTree-class scan speed when run as administrator, with a portable parallel walker as fallback.
en-US.name: mathom
